crossRefs.note: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

translations.web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
translations.bsb: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
translations.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
translations.asv: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind in his father, though he sought is diligently with tears.
